fields.label: Cloud Exadata Infrastructure Arn
fields.help: The unique identifier of the Exadata infrastructure for this VM cluster.

fields.label: Cloud Exadata Infrastructure ID
fields.help: The unique identifier of the Exadata infrastructure for this VM cluster.

fields.label: Cluster Name
fields.help: The name of the Grid Infrastructure (GI) cluster.

fields.label: Cpu Core Count
fields.help: The number of CPU cores to enable on the VM cluster.

fields.label: Data Storage Size In Tbs
fields.help: The size of the data disk group, in terabytes (TBs), to allocate for the VM cluster.

fields.label: DB Node Storage Size In Gbs
fields.help: The amount of local node storage, in gigabytes (GBs), to allocate for the VM cluster.

fields.label: DB Servers
fields.help: The list of database servers for the VM cluster.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: A user-friendly name for the VM cluster.

fields.label: Gi Version
fields.help: A valid software version of Oracle Grid Infrastructure (GI).

fields.label: Hostname Prefix
fields.help: The host name prefix for the VM cluster.

fields.label: Is Local Backup Enabled
fields.help: Specifies whether to enable database backups to local Exadata storage for the VM cluster.

fields.label: Is Sparse Diskgroup Enabled
fields.help: Specifies whether to create a sparse disk group for the VM cluster.

fields.label: License Model
fields.help: The Oracle license model to apply to the VM cluster.

fields.label: Memory Size In Gbs
fields.help: The amount of memory, in gigabytes (GBs), to allocate for the VM cluster.

fields.label: Odb Network Arn
fields.help: The unique identifier of the ODB network for the VM cluster.

fields.label: Odb Network ID
fields.help: The unique identifier of the ODB network for the VM cluster.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints).

fields.label: Scan Listener Port Tcp
fields.help: The port number for TCP connections to the single client access name (SCAN) listener.

fields.label: SSH Public Keys
fields.help: The public key portion of one or more key pairs used for SSH access to the VM cluster.

fields.label: Timezone
fields.help: The configured time zone of the VM cluster.

fields.label: Data Collection Options
fields.help: The set of preferences for the various diagnostic collection options for the VM cluster.
